hooks.name: Lint after agent edits
hooks.description: After the agent edits a source file (fs_write/str_replace/fs_append), run ESLint and fix any warnings/errors it surfaces.

action.prompt: You just edited one or more files. Run `npm run lint` now. If ESLint reports any warnings or errors, fix them at the source (do not disable rules, add eslint-disable comments, or rename to the `_`-ignore pattern just to silence a real unused symbol). Prefer removing genuinely dead code and correcting the underlying issue. After fixing, re-run `npm run lint` to confirm it is clean (0 problems). If the only remaining findings are pre-existing and unrelated to your edit, note them briefly rather than fixing unrelated code.

hooks.name: Lint after file save
hooks.description: When the user saves a JS source file, run ESLint and fix any warnings/errors it surfaces.

action.prompt: The user just saved a JavaScript file. Run `npm run lint` now. If ESLint reports any warnings or errors, fix them at the source (do not disable rules, add eslint-disable comments, or rename to the `_`-ignore pattern just to silence a real unused symbol). Prefer removing genuinely dead code and correcting the underlying issue. After fixing, re-run `npm run lint` to confirm it is clean (0 problems). If the only remaining findings are pre-existing and unrelated to the saved file, note them briefly rather than fixing unrelated code.
